title: 6 ChatGPT Prompts Every Founder Needs
caption:
Most people ask AI like a search engine. Founders ask it like a consultant. 🧠

6 prompts I run every week:

1️⃣ “Act as my fractional CFO — find my 3 biggest money leaks”
2️⃣ “List 10 objections my buyer has, then rewrite my page for each”
3️⃣ “Give me 5 pricing options and the psychology behind each”
4️⃣ “Audit this competitor: offer, audience, weakness, gap”
5️⃣ “Turn this call transcript into a follow-up email + next steps”
6️⃣ “What would a 10x version of my business do differently?”

Copy them. Paste them. Steal them. ⚡

Save 📌 — you'll use these weekly.
